tierComparisons.label: 10 GB (R2 Free Tier)
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Ideal for initial launch and curated high-priority Angkor heritage corpus (100% Free).

tierComparisons.label: 25 GB
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Extremely affordable ($0.23/mo R2). Covers broad museum collections.

tierComparisons.label: 50 GB
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Supports comprehensive national heritage catalog across all 12 cultural categories ($0.60/mo).

tierComparisons.label: 100 GB
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Full-scale national archive with deep multi-angle photographic surveys ($1.35/mo).

tierComparisons.label: 250 GB
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Large institutional scale. Still under $3.60/mo with zero egress fees on R2.

tierComparisons.label: 500 GB
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Massive archive including high-definition video performances and audio recordings ($7.35/mo).

tierComparisons.label: 1 TB (1,000 GB)
tierComparisons.recommendationNotes: Exhaustive historical repository ($14.85/mo on R2 or $5.94/mo on B2).

storageArchitectureAnalysis.r2FreeTierAssessment: Cloudflare R2 provides 10 GB of free persistent storage every month with $0 egress bandwidth fees. With our multi-resolution WebP optimization (~680 KB per complete CDN variant set), the platform can host up to ~14,700 items completely free of charge.
storageArchitectureAnalysis.detailedRationale: Cloudflare R2 (current single bucket with versioned prefix /v1/) is strongly recommended for the first 10,000–50,000 items. Zero egress fees eliminate unpredictable bandwidth bills. If video or raw uncompressed master archives exceed 250 GB in future phases, a hybrid model (R2 for web-optimized CDN assets + Backblaze B2 for cold master archival preservation) can be introduced seamlessly.

rateLimitObservations: Met Museum Collection API operated with 100ms request delays with 0 rate limit violations.
Smithsonian Open Access Freer-Sackler records parsed at 120ms intervals with 0 errors.
Wikimedia Commons MediaWiki Generator Search operated cleanly at 80ms intervals.

knownLimitations: Met Museum Open Access search endpoint does not expose Content-Length header directly in list responses; empirical archival dimensions and pilot measurements were used for byte size estimation.
Smithsonian Freer-Sackler records provide direct delivery URLs for TIFF/JPEG masters; high-resolution scan averages are used.
Wikimedia Commons exposes exact byte size metadata in imageinfo, providing 100% measured accuracy for open media assets.
